note: Owner decision 2026-10-20: Claude Haiku 5.5 is the one enabled model, under a hard monthly dollar cap (env AI_PAID_CAP_USD, default 5, enforced in src/ai/router.py from the usage store). To add a model: add a provider entry with a kind that has an adapter in src/ai/router.py (ADAPTER_KINDS), put its id in `order`, and set `enabled` to true. A provider is also off when its env key is missing, so a flag set early does nothing until the key exists. Free-tier (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter) and local (Ollama) adapters are parked: not written, not listed.
